items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: In fact, there's one out in San Diego. Phillip Andrine and that bunch of bands.

ctx.x: The Dixie Cats, yes. Now, since those days, I must have seen 300 bands named Dixie Cats in different spellings. But every town has got a band named the Dixie Cats. In fact, there's one out in San Diego. Phillip Andrine and that bunch of bands. And that's the Dixie Cats with a K-A-T-Z. Dixie Cats. But that was something. We had a bass drum logo and everything. A tomcat in a zoot suit swinging a chain.
